Going up would leave number 13 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going left would cut off the right side (6 cells). So the line goes down.

Going left would leave both cell (5,5) and cell (7,5) needing the line next, and it can't do both; going down would leave both cell (7,5) and cell (7,7) needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes right.
